evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: We talk to different customers everyday. Some of their concerns are either movers not showing up on time or damages to their items or any of this or concerns as well.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'I'm not particularly worried about that I guess' — Joanna acknowledged with 'Mm-hmm' but did not probe deeper with follow-up questions.
evidence_quotes.value_days: No mention of Value Days, day flexibility, or cheaper alternatives.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: There's no deposit needed for this move. The payment is only upon completion of the move... if that's all good with you I can definitely put you on the schedule.

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details efficiently (two addresses, floor count, walking distances, furniture list, box count) and delivered a clear, anchored estimate with transparent pricing and all-inclusive framing.
coaching_note: Step 2 requires two layers of follow-up: when Zoe said she wasn't worried, Joanna should have probed deeper ("tell me more about that") rather than moving immediately to reassurance; and Step 5 needs the prep framing and temperature check ("How do you feel about that?") before asking about booking.
